# COWIN MAGNET

> COWIN MAGNET is the brand used by Quzhou Qiying Import & Export Co., Ltd for magnetic separation equipment sourcing and export communication support.

- [Home](https://www.cowinmagnet.com/en)

- [Contact](https://www.cowinmagnet.com/en/contact)
- [Request a quote](https://www.cowinmagnet.com/en/request-quote)

## Product areas

- Suspended and overband magnetic separators
- Electromagnetic separators
- Magnetic drums, rollers and pulleys
- Eddy current metal sorting equipment
- Magnetic bars, grids, filters and pipeline separators
